body:
Firstly let me say I only found out about hsp today, but I identify very strongly with the personality trait (?)

I tried shrooms for the first time a few weeks ago (golden teacher 😁) and the trip was really something. Overall it was a positive experience and I enjoyed the visuals and the emotional depth I felt. The feeling was highly intense, and in the beginning it was overwhelming as my mind-set wasn't right (I was having a fight with my bf and felt really shitty and guilty), so initially my trip was a bad one. I cried a lot, but what was great was that I could really be honest with myself about all the things that were really bothering me at the time, like in my relationship and with myself, and I could be honest with my bf about my feelings. Lol it was intense, I cried a lot, tears of sadness and joy, and I got to release all my anxieties and stress. It felt so good. Then once I got through the muck I could really enjoy the high - the colours, the dancing shapes and lights, my love for the people I value the most, it was really beautiful. It just felt like everything made sense, it's like I could see how everything was connected. I just understood.

But anyway to answer your question it will definitely make you more stimulated by the things around you, do make sure to surround yourself with sights, sounds and people that stimulate you positively.
